description: Wetterabhängige Jahresübersicht der Dauerzählstellen Radverkehr is a series of datasets listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Der Datensatz enthält die Daten der Zählstellen für den Radverkehr in Düsseldorf in Abhängigkeit zum Wetter für 2024. Die Messergebnisse werden im Stunden-Takt erfasst. Die erfassten Daten können im Jahresvergleich abweichen, da bei den Zahlen der Radfahrer auch immer das entsprechende Wetter am Messtag berücksichtigt werden muss. Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal lists 12 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. Its tags are freizeit, kultur, sport-und-tourismus, transport-und-verkehr. It offers 42 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
